title: [GOOD] Comprehensive edge case handling in sequence number freshness
description:
File: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs
Lines: 540-580, 807-886

What's good: The seq_is_fresher function implements half-window sequence number comparison correctly with thorough edge case testing:
- Equal values (not fresher)
- Simple increment/decrement
- Wraparound at u16 boundaries (0xFFFF -> 0x0000)
- Half-window boundary exactly at 0x8000
- Near-half-window values (0x7FFF)

The tests cover 14 specific edge cases including both boundaries of the wrapping arithmetic. This is well-designed replay protection.

Worth defending: This is a textbook implementation of RFC 6621 sequence freshness semantics. Any 'simplification' would likely introduce subtle bugs.
close_reason: Acknowledged: Positive observation about comprehensive edge case handling in sequence number freshness.
